strings.สำหรับผู้ดูแล: โฟลเดอร์อัปเดตระบบ: For administrators: the system update folder
strings.เครื่องมือนำงานที่ตรวจผ่านเข้าระบบอ้างอิ: The tool that brings checked work into the system always points at the project's main folder, even when called from a working copy, so the work folder and the update log are never nested inside the copy.
strings.ใช้ทางลัด ON / OFF บนเดสก์ท็อปเพื่อเปิดห: Use the ON / OFF shortcut on the desktop to start or stop the limit tracker. It runs at low priority so it does not compete for resources. OFF stops the tracker, but AI jobs already started carry on.
strings.Settings → ประสิทธิภาพของเครื่อง Hub มีอ: Settings → Hub performance has Automatic, Economy, Balanced and Faster. In the technical details you can set the processor, thread count, parallel jobs and memory kept free. Each PC keeps its own values and the model you chose. Saving takes effect on the next load; open threads and translation batches need the voice helper reopened, and running work is not closed.
strings.ภาพ 3D เลือกตามอุปกรณ์ที่เปิดเว็บและปรับ: The 3D view is chosen for the device that opens the page and can be adjusted. The economy view lowers resolution and the number of frames drawn while keeping the same movement and collision checks. Edges use the new value when the page is loaded again.
strings.งบ RAM/VRAM ใช้ช่วยเลือกวิธีโหลด ไม่รับป: The RAM/VRAM budget helps choose how to load; it does not guarantee a hard cap on total use. A detected GPU still needs its libraries ready; if it cannot be used, the CPU is used instead.
strings.ทุกหน้ามีช่องเลือกภาษาข้างสวิตช์ \"แสดงร: Every page has a language box next to the "Show technical details" switch. The default is Thai. Text without a translation shows in English. The choice is shared by every app on this hub, and another open tab offers a reload when it changes. A new language is one file (language name + English → translation pairs), no code to change.
strings.Mice Hub — ศูนย์กลางควบคุมและปรับแต่งทุก: Mice Hub — the center that controls and tunes every system
strings.โปรแกรมเซิร์ฟเวอร์หลักของระบบ ค้นหาโมดูล: The system's main server program. It automatically finds every ESP32 module and board on the network and USB ports, shares ports and distributes commands to every application.
strings.ธีมและตัวเลือกธีมซิงก์ระหว่างหน้าและแท็บ: Themes and theme options sync across pages and tabs open on the same hub. Clearing the theme returns the colours and options to their defaults together.
strings.เครื่องมือแต่ละรายการแสดงเพียงครั้งเดียว: Each tool appears only once, in the first category that matches. If no category matches yet, it shows under Other Tools.
strings.จุดที่ 1: การเชื่อมต่อโมดูลและพอร์ต USB: Point 1: connecting modules and USB ports (Home & Transports)
strings.เลือกโหมดเชื่อมต่อในแถบตั้งค่าก่อนสั่ง C: Choose the connection mode in the settings bar before pressing Connect.
strings.Hub จะแชร์พอร์ต COM เดียวกัน ทำให้เปิด N: The hub shares the same COM port, so Nong Studio and a board's web page can be open together without the cable colliding.
strings.หน้าเดียวจะยึดสายไว้ ตอบสนองเร็วกว่า 2-5: One page holds the cable. It responds 2-5 ms faster, but other pages cannot talk to the board.
strings.ดูรายชื่อการ์ดบอร์ดที่ Hub ตรวจจับได้อัต: See the list of board cards the hub detects automatically (IP, board type, capabilities).
strings.Hub จะส่งคำสั่ง Probe เบาๆ ทางสาย USB /: The hub sends a light probe command over USB / RS485 / WiFi to check which kind of board it is (nong, lift, cam, gacha), with no setup needed.
strings.เปิดแดชบอร์ดเฉพาะบอร์ด (Open Module): Open a board's own dashboard (Open Module)
strings.เปิดหน้าเว็บประจำตัวของ ESP32 บอร์ดนั้น: It opens that ESP32 board's own web page, to adjust hardware pins, see RAM status or test driving the motor directly.

strings.รายการปรับตามขนาดหน้าจอ ไม่มีคอลัมน์หมวด: The list adapts to the screen size, with no empty category columns and no repeated guide button in each card. Open the guide from the link.
strings.เด่นชัดบนแถบเมนูด้านบนของ Hub เปิดคู่มือ: It stands out on the hub's top menu bar and opens the guide in a new tab. If the list cannot load, an error is shown with a button.
strings.ส่วนรายการว่างจะแจ้งว่ายังไม่มีเครื่องมื: An empty list says there are no tools yet.

strings.Hub จะตรวจพบแอปใหม่และนำมาแสดงผลบนหน้านี: The hub detects the new app and shows it on this page automatically at once, with no back-end code change at all.

Apps that need a friend's program (Reconize, Photobooth, All-Jao) do not show on a PC without that program. Removing only hides the app on this PC and deletes no files, and if the hub's folder is moved or renamed, a friend's app beside it is still found.

strings.เลือกบอร์ดปลายทางแล้วกด: Choose the target board and press
strings.Hub จะส่งคำสั่งรีบูตบอร์ดเข้าโหมด Bootlo: The hub sends a command to reboot the board into bootloader mode and writes the program to the ESP32 chip, with a percentage progress bar.
strings.จุดที่ 4: การตั้งค่าเครือข่ายและการจับคู: Point 4: network settings and module pairing (Network & Pairing)
strings.พิมพ์ชื่อ WiFi และรหัสผ่าน แล้วกดส่งเข้า: Type the WiFi name and password, then press send to every module.
strings.บอร์ดทุกตัวจะเชื่อมต่อเข้ากับ WiFi ของสถ: Every board connects to the venue's WiFi at the same time, without plugging a cable into each one in turn.
strings.รหัสจับคู่ระหว่างโมดูล (Peer Pairing Cod: Pairing code between modules (Peer Pairing Code)
strings.ป้อนรหัส 6 หลักเพื่อจับคู่โมดูลเข้ากลุ่ม: Enter a 6-digit code to pair modules into the same group.
strings.โมดูลจะสื่อสารหากันเฉพาะในกลุ่มของตนเอง: Modules talk only within their own group, which prevents signals interfering between booths when several robots are at the same event.
strings.จุดที่ 5: การตั้งค่าระบบ ธีม และการสำเนา: Point 5: system settings, themes and data copies (Settings & Diagnostics)
strings.เปลี่ยนโทนสีของทุกหน้าเว็บพร้อมกันทันที: Changes the colour tone of every web page at once. For a dark hall, the Midnight theme is recommended so it is easy on the eyes.
strings.รวบรวม Log ความเร็วเครือข่าย ค่าคอนฟิก แ: button collects the network speed log, config values and error history to the clipboard, with passwords removed automatically for safety.
strings.เมื่อค้นหาอุปกรณ์ไม่สำเร็จ หน้าแรกจะแจ้ง: When searching for devices fails, the home page asks you to try again. The old list in Modules still works with its buttons but says it may be out of date. Network separates boards with the same name by the device itself and keeps the result of grouping commands after a refresh.
strings.ภาพประกอบคู่มือรวมมากับ Hub ใช้ได้โดยไม่: The guide's illustrations are included with the hub, so they work without an internet connection or copying a separate image folder. When the source images change, the version check also tells you to rebuild the program.
strings.เปิดผลงานล่าสุดพร้อมท่าและเพลง: Open the latest work with its moves and music
strings.หน้าแรก Hub มีแอป: The hub's home page has the app
strings.สำหรับชุดงานที่ติดตั้งไว้ เครื่องที่ยังไ: for installed works. A PC that has no list yet can import a file directly. In Nong Studio press
strings.เปิดผลงานพร้อมเพลง: Open a work with its music
strings.แล้วเลือกคลิป หรือเลือกไฟล์ ซึ่งเก็บท่า: then choose a clip, or choose a file that keeps the moves, the rig and the music in one file. The file is read and checked before your work changes. If you have unsaved work you are asked to Save or cancel first, with a choice of using the work's rig or keeping the current settings. Using a rig different from the original may change the moves or timing under the new limits.
strings.เพื่อดูท่าในหน้าจอพร้อมเพลงเดิม หยุด กลั: to see the moves on screen with the original music. You can pause, go back to the start or move the time bar. The music is the preview's clock, so it never runs apart from the moves when a tab is slow. If the music ends before the moves, the rest is silent, and a loop restarts the music when the moves end. Opening a work or using this preview sends nothing to the real robot. The Run on robot button is a separate step.
strings.เก็บเพลงไว้ในโปรเจกต์ด้วย เปิดใหม่ยังมีเ: The music is kept in the project too, so it is still there when you reopen it, or press
strings.เพื่อย้ายไฟล์เดียวไปเครื่องอื่น เพลงของ: to move a single file to another PC. A draft's music is kept separately in the browser; if that storage is closed or cleared you may need to choose the original file again, while the recovered moves are still there. For the real robot, use the YAML file and an MP3 with the same name as the play: command on the SD card, uploaded the usual way. The system does not upload or start the robot for you.
strings.เครื่องที่วาด 3D ไม่ได้ (ทีวี/คอมเก่า/เบ: A device that cannot draw 3D (a TV, an old computer, or a browser with the graphics card turned off):
strings.Studio ยังเปิดและใช้ได้ สไลเดอร์ ไทม์ไลน: Studio still opens and works. The sliders, the timeline and playing on the robot work as normal, while the 3D robot view shows a message that this device cannot draw it. To see the robot, open it with a newer browser or another computer.
strings.คุณภาพภาพ 3D เลือกอัตโนมัติจากอุปกรณ์ที่: The 3D view quality is chosen automatically from the device that opens the page. Change it in Hub → Settings → 3D view. The economy mode lowers the number of frames and the resolution while keeping the same playback timing and collision checks. Edges use the new value after the page is loaded again.

A robot with the new firmware takes it as a command; an older robot skips this line and plays as before (stopping at every key). Studio checks collisions on the smoothed path with the same clearance as before. A move whose curve would collide goes back to stopping at the keys along the checked straight line. The robot also checks by itself: if it is too fast for the servo or the time is stretched, it plays as before. Four cheer sequences: the stops in the middle of a move dropped from 226–429 to 35–101 (not yet tried on the real robot).

strings.Voice และตัวสร้างเสียงแบบมีอารมณ์ที่ Hub: Voice and the emotional speech maker are managed by the hub. They share the hub's performance values: the main listening, language-specific listening and the fallback to CPU use the same thread budget and parallel jobs. A model that is already open keeps its old values, and translation from several requests uses the same batch. Some thread values need the voice helper reopened. The Voice status shows which version of the values is loaded and says when values are waiting for the next load, without changing the model, character or service you chose.

strings.จุดรับของ (Receive) และจุดปล่อยของ (Drop: The receive point (Receive) and the drop point (Drop) are on the same side. The Hall sensor is fixed at the receive point only; all 4 magnets are attached to the rotating wheel. The drop side has no Hall sensor.

strings.ค่าเริ่มต้น Automatic ตรวจคนหลายคนและการ: The default, Automatic, detects several people and camera angle changes in a new clip by itself. With Automatic or Group dance, the system compares the movement across the whole clip every time, and does not fix male/female positions in advance. People whose arms are the same but whose waist twist or shoulder tilt differ may end up in different routines. Choose Dance routine to see each one, or Save separate routines to save, as separate projects, the routines with continuously different evidence and reliable pictures through the picture ratio set in the defaults. A Fragment is a stretch that cannot yet be confirmed as a new routine; it is kept to view and save one at a time, and every camera cut is not counted as a new dance routine. If a new angle cannot be matched clearly to an earlier routine, the system uses the dancers' appearance together with matching every group at once, and marks check cut when the match is still unclear. A new angle whose match is still unclear keeps the pose and is not turned into reliable just because the time has passed. Only when several people seen in that picture really do the same pose is the confirmed shared pose used. The % reliable report is the share of usable pictures, not a guarantee that it is the same person. Users may choose people themselves as an option.
strings.ภาพตัดที่จับคู่คนเดิมไม่ได้:: A cut that cannot be matched to the same person:
strings.ระบบแยกเป็น Scene segment อัตโนมัติ เลือ: The system automatically splits it into scene segments and picks the main dancer who is seen continuously in that routine, not switching with every picture's confidence value. Each part's video range and move timing start in line. When you edit the video range, the earlier reading is cancelled and the new range is analysed, without adding a long standing-still before the visible stretch. Make and save saves the routines or ranges that pass the criteria separately, and does not create a show that guesses different moves are the same person. An unclear cross-camera match is not a guarantee of gender or of the same person.
strings.ค่าเริ่มต้นรักษารูปท่าและเพิ่มเวลาตามขีด: The default keeps the shape of the pose and adds time according to the robot's limits. To keep the original musical beat, choose Stay with the music, which may reduce the range of movement. The system filters jitter over time, cutting short reversals and sudden joint-angle changes. When a person holds still after changing pose, the robot still moves to the pose it accepted before holding, and does not stop halfway because of the filter. The opening pose and the standing-still stretches are kept, and no pose from the future is pulled in to fill pictures that cannot be seen. After filtering, collisions and timing are checked again and the number of reversals before and after is shown. The original pictures and the error report are still used to check whether filtering has eaten too much pose detail. The rig and the motor limits may leave some poses still different from the person.
strings.ตามวิดีโอคนเดียวหรือเต้นหมู่: Follow a single-person video or a group dance
strings.ช่วงอ้อมที่ช้ากว่าความเร็วต่ำสุดของตัวเล: A detour slower than the video player's lowest speed moves the picture one frame at a time by the robot's clock, with the sound paused. Use Play both to stop or resume. Changing the video or the mode restores normal speed and cancels the earlier reading at once. The original music is not sent to be attached to a sequence whose time has been stretched, because the beat would drift; a time-adjusted music file must be used. For cheer sequences, a time-adjusted music file is provided as a pair.
strings.หน้า Video เลือก Performers เป็น One per: On the Video page, choose Performers as One performer or Group dance, and choose Camera as One camera view or Changing shots / viewpoints, separately. After the clip is read, performer numbers appear to choose in Follow. Different routines, such as those of a male and a female dancer, are not averaged together. Check and save each person or each routine under its own name.
strings.Turn the waist ใช้มุมลำตัวสัมพันธ์กับสะโ: Turn the waist uses the torso angle relative to the hips, and Follow shoulder tilt uses the shoulder angle relative to the torso, checked against the real mechanism in the rig. A person who stands still does not pull in a future pose to fill in, and nothing is smoothed across a cut. A side or overhead camera is checked within the torso frame before a new pose is accepted.
strings.Learned camera checks ใช้นโยบาย Q-learni: Learned camera checks uses a Q-learning policy trained in a simulator to help decide whether to accept a pose, keep the old pose, or compensate for the viewpoint. It is compared with the geometric method before being switched on. If the person is blocked, it is not certain it is the same person, or the person's rotation cannot be separated from the camera's, it keeps the last reliable pose. The simulator results do not confirm accuracy on real clips.
strings.ตรวจแผ่นมือ ลูกบอลข้อต่อ ก้านแขน ลำตัว แ: Checks the hand plates, joint balls, arm rods, torso and head against the real pose, including the shoulder lift. Every part must be at least 10 mm apart (to allow for servo gear play; settable in safe_path.json as clearMm plus the rig's allowance). A destination pose that collides first looks for a nearby free pose, then uses RRT* to find a detour, and the checks and timing are done again after the corners are rounded. The preview, the project and the exported commands use the same checked pose set. Stay with the music may reduce the movement range when the robot cannot keep up. If it is off, it keeps the pose and adds time to move or detour, so the preview video slows down to the robot's pace. A repeated pose does not collapse or rewind the music time.
strings.ไม่ต้องกดอะไร ทำงานเองกับทุกท่า: ชุดท่าใ: No button to press; it works by itself with every move: sequences in Studio, moves from a video, detours that Studio finds, speaking moves, moves from RL and Shows. If a joint keeps going the same way, the arm runs on through the keyframe instead of stopping at every key. Where a joint reverses (a flick), where there is a hold, and at the start and end, it still stops exactly on the key. The timing of every move is unchanged, so it still matches the music. It can be turned on or off by where a move came from, in the file (sources). A move file made outside Studio (such as RL) uses . The smoother can never make a move jerkier than before: any key where the curve would be jerkier than stopping at every key is slowed down by itself (). For a move from RL that was downsampled from a detailed 50-per-second move, the arm passes each key at the original move's speed and sticks to the original path that was already checked for collisions ().
strings.กด <b>Start a new event and reset counts: Press Start a new event and reset counts to begin a new event and zero every machine's counts (you are always asked to confirm first)
strings.• <b>Mute all speech:</b> ปุ่มเล็กในกล่อ: • Mute all speech: the small button in the quick-speech box; it stops all speech that is playing right now
strings.ย้อนกลับ / ทำซ้ำ (กดผิดก็ไม่เสียงาน): Undo / Redo (a wrong tap does not lose your work)
strings.ไม่เปลี่ยนหุ่น ย้อนเฉพาะท่าบนไทม์ไลน์ในจ: The robot does not change. Only the poses on the timeline on screen go back. If you already saved to the robot, save to the robot again.
strings.กดปุ่ม ↶ Undo ในแถบเวลา (ข้างปุ่มซูม) หร: Press ↶ Undo in the time bar (beside the zoom buttons), or Ctrl+Z, to take back the last change, for example a keyframe deleted by mistake. Press ↷ Redo or Ctrl+Y to put it back. You can go back many steps. Dragging or typing a value in one go counts as one step. Opening a file or a show starts a fresh history.
strings.เลือกชุดสีจากกล่องสีที่แถบบนสุดของ Studi: Pick a colour set from the box in the top bar of Studio. Midnight is the dark mode and is easier on the eyes for long sessions. The 3D view changes its background too. It is the same colour set as the other Hub pages, so a choice made anywhere applies everywhere.
strings.ไม่เปลี่ยนหุ่นและไม่เปลี่ยนไฟล์ท่า เปลี่: The robot and your move files do not change. Only the colours of the screen on this computer.
strings.Save ถามก่อนทับชื่อเดิม (ใช้สองแท็บก็ไม่: Save asks before replacing a name (two tabs cannot overwrite each other)
strings.ตอนกด Save Studio จะถามฮับว่าชื่อนี้มีไฟ: When you press Save, Studio asks the hub whether that name is already taken. If another tab or another person has just saved this name, a window asks whether to replace it. Press Cancel and type a new name to keep both files.
strings.ไม่เปลี่ยนหุ่น ไฟล์เดิมจะไม่ถูกทับถ้าคุณ: The robot does not change. The old file is left alone if you press Cancel.
strings.วิดีโอที่แทบไม่เห็นคน (บอกเป็นคำพูด): A video with hardly any person (said in words)
strings.หลังกด Make moves ถ้า Studio เห็นคนในวิด: After Make moves, if Studio can see a person in less than a quarter of the video, it first says "I could hardly see a person in this video" and suggests a video where the whole person, arms included, is in the picture. The detailed numbers (short reversals, uncertain moments) are behind Show technical details.
strings.ไม่เปลี่ยนหุ่น เป็นแค่ข้อความช่วยตัดสินใ: The robot does not change. This is only a message to help you decide before putting moves on the time bar.
strings.ชื่อโปรเจกต์ใช้ตัวอักษรไทยและอังกฤษ ตัวเ: A project name may use Thai and English letters, numbers, spaces and _ - . but not emoji, / \ :, or names Windows reserves (such as con, nul, com1). The page says so in plain words and nothing already saved is overwritten.
strings.ลิงก์วิดีโอในวงแลน (เช่น NAS): Video links on the venue network (for example a NAS)
strings.ลิงก์จากอินเทอร์เน็ตและการอัปโหลดไฟล์ใช้: Internet links and file upload work as usual. A link that points at this PC or the venue network is refused for safety. If the video sits on a device on the LAN, such as a NAS, the admin adds that device's name or address to lanHosts in config/video_links.json and restarts the hub. This PC itself and cloud addresses are always refused.
strings.ไม่เปลี่ยนหุ่น เป็นแค่การเลือกว่าลิงก์ไห: Does not change the robot. It only chooses which links the hub will fetch a video from.
